title: CAREER RAIDS: THE 10 MINUTE CLOCK
why: His mode design of 2026-10-12: CAREER is the arcade mode with the Undercroft, 10 minute raids, and his rule that the gameplay is exactly the same in DEMO and CAREER. Every raid you take up from the Undercroft is now a CAREER raid: it runs on the DEMO clock, 10 minutes instead of 9, and the extraction rings never close early, so the clock and the burn at zero are the pressure, as in the DEMO. Your own kit from the stash, full enemy damage and coming back empty after a death are unchanged. The kill score, the waves and the payout build on this in the next builds.
now: Raids from the Undercroft are CAREER raids: 10 minutes, and the rings stay open until the clock runs out.
